# Hybrid Playwright + MCP Test Automation Project

This project combines standard Playwright testing with MCP browser tools for enhanced automation.

## Project Structure
- `/tests` - Test files (standard and hybrid)
- `/pages` - Page Object Model classes (standard and hybrid)
- `/mcp` - MCP browser helpers and demos

## Testing Guidelines
- Use Page Object Model pattern for maintainability
- Combine Playwright and MCP tools based on need
- Use MCP for enhanced browser interactions and debugging
- Use standard Playwright for assertions and test structure
- Follow JavaScript best practices
